title: The Loose Extraction Again
author: Elodie Okonkwo
blurb: Oscar Dravenmoor, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
